title: Status Monitoring
description: Service status with uptime bars, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Badge, Button, Card, Indicator and Skeleton primitives: an overall status badge, then one card per service with its live status, a bar per day tinted by how that day went, and its uptime, with its own empty, loading and error renders; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — the header and each service's name and status line up at @sm, taller bars and a larger heading at @md, two services a row at @lg.
